description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving Slobad +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping Slobad
When Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
When Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
